front.intro: Hardi Plank siding and a new roof cover the outside of this East End bungalow, and a new driveway runs back along the side of the house. Inside are new wiring, new plumbing and three-phase power, with a new kitchen and two new baths. Wood-look floors run from the front door through the Living Room, the Dining Area and the Kitchen. Interior laundry. Coral Sword and Greenway Coffee on Telephone Road are under half a mile away.

caps.name: Front of the Home
caps.text: A board and batten gable sits over the covered stoop at the front of the bungalow. A short flight of steps leads up to the stoop.

caps.name: Front Entry
caps.text: The front door opens straight into the Living Room, with the Dining Area and the Kitchen beyond it. The flooring carries from the door to the Kitchen with no thresholds between rooms. A tall double-pane window faces the street.

left.title: Living, Kitchen and the Breakfast Nook

cookItems.name: Kitchen
cookItems.text: The Kitchen is laid out in an L with a peninsula that opens to the Dining Area and the Living Room. The range, the sink and the dishwasher sit a step apart along the L. A pantry measuring 4' x 3' is just around the corner.

cookItems.name: Breakfast Bar
cookItems.text: The peninsula doubles as the Breakfast Bar between the Kitchen and the Dining Area. Two pendant lights hang above it. The Dining Area is right beside the bar.

gatherItems.name: Living Room
gatherItems.text: The Living Room is the first room inside, facing the street. A tall window looks out to the front, and a long clerestory window sits high on the wall for light and privacy. A wide cased opening leads on through the Dining Area and into the Kitchen, over wood-look floors the whole way. A ceiling fan with a light hangs at the center, and the room measures 16' x 13'.

gatherItems.name: Dining Area
gatherItems.text: The Dining Area sits between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. The front door and the Living Room are on one side of it.

gatherItems.name: Breakfast Nook
gatherItems.text: The Breakfast Nook sits beside the Kitchen, with a door out to the rear deck and the backyard.

primItems.name: Primary Bedroom
primItems.text: A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam, in the rear corner of the house away from the street. A double-door closet and the doorway to the Primary Bath share one wall.

primItems.name: Primary Closet
primItems.text: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides. The built-ins stay with the house. Shelves sit above the rods.

bbItems.name: Primary Bath
bbItems.text: Double sinks sit on a dark navy vanity with drawers. The glass shower has a rain showerhead and a handheld, and marble-look tile from floor to ceiling. Brushed-finish faucets match the shower fixtures.

bbItems.name: Hall Bath
bbItems.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share the hall bath, a few steps from each. A window sits above the tub. Open shelves for linens line the wall beside the vanity.

bbItems.name: Bedroom 2
bbItems.text: The larger secondary bedroom sits at the front corner, across the home from the Primary. It shares the hall bath with Bedroom 3.

bbItems.name: Bedroom 3
bbItems.text: The hall bath is a few steps away. It has a large window, and a reach-in closet sits beside the door. The room sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary.

back.title: Outside, and around the house

photos.name: Covered Garage
photos.text: The covered garage sits at the back of the lot, beside an open concrete patio that measures 8' x 25'. The driveway ends at the garage. The whole yard is fenced.

photos.name: Backyard Deck
photos.text: Steps lead from the Breakfast Nook's rear door down to the deck. The deck looks out over the backyard. The rear of the house shows the same Hardi Plank siding as the front.

rooms.label: Front rooms
rooms.text: Three main rooms open one into the next, from the front door back to the Kitchen. A door in the Breakfast Nook leads out to the rear deck. The Kitchen has a peninsula and a 4' x 3' pantry.

rooms.label: Bedrooms and baths
rooms.text: The Primary Bedroom is at the back of the house, with a vaulted ceiling. The Primary Bath has double sinks and a walk-in shower. The two secondary bedrooms use the hall bath. Each bedroom has a closet.

rooms.label: Outdoor spaces
rooms.text: A covered garage and an 8' x 25' patio sit side by side at the back of the lot, at the end of the new driveway. A deck with steps leads out from the Breakfast Nook.

rooms.label: Rooftop
rooms.text: A rooftop patio is up the last flight. It looks toward the downtown skyline. A door at the top of the stair opens to the roof.
